@syntax Abs(value)
The size of a number without its sign, so -3 and 3 both give 3. A float stays a float and an integer stays an integer. For an unsigned type, the number is never negative to begin with.

```blitzbasic
;run
Print Abs(-3)
Print Abs(2.5)
Print Abs(-2.5)
```

```text
3
2.5
2.5
```
